about.amounts: amountMinor is in the currency's minor unit (cents, pence; INR paise). 1999 = 19.99. Prices are the regular price after any free trial or intro offer.

about.taxes: US prices exclude sales tax. UK, EU, AU, NZ and IN prices include VAT/GST.
